notes: nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b for LiteRT (litert-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b): nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (revision ea30d66d, openmdw-1.1), a cache-aware streaming FastConformer encoder with an RNN-T decoder and a language prompt, rewritten as plain PyTorch graphs (no NeMo) and exported with litert-torch 0.10.0 for LiteRT 2.3.0 at lookahead 3 (320 ms chunks): mel, pre (the subsampling with its convolution caches), the 24-layer conformer with its attention and convolution caches as graph inputs and outputs, and the RNN-T decoder (predict, joint); the host carries the caches from chunk to chunk and runs the greedy RNN-T loop (at most 10 tokens per encoder frame). The float16 conformers scale each of their 144 LayerNorm inputs by 2^-k (k 2-9) so float16 arithmetic stays finite. Accuracy = WER (CER for FLEURS Japanese) against the reference: transformers 5.22.1 Nemotron3_5AsrForRNNT in float32 on the same chunks with the same 5,520 zeros appended, greedy decoding, each set's language-locale as the prompt; L = the Open ASR Leaderboard's scoring, J = jiwer on the same normalized text. This file: nemotron_asr_decoder_f32.tflite (94,969,956 B; the card's Files table: the same in float32; backend CPU (beside the GPU conformer, and in the Python example)). artifact_sha256 = = the work graph dec_fp32.tflite that the Mac runs loaded (their meta lines name it). LANDED: nemotron_asr_decoder_f32.tflite (sha256 8a14e05f09b80eca1729748e0db7b3fde6926d7729dd6ee659eeb3b2c4ab7cc8, 94,969,956 B) is in litert-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b from commit b2a2190cd36b4ca2e43a4f77b5af4c0165db559f (uploaded 2026-11-03 14:02 JST); the Hub tree read at 2026-11-03T14:15:43+09:00 (main b2a2190c) gives this LFS oid and size. Mac, 2026-11-02: the card's first Accuracy table, one result per set and per run that loaded this file, FLEURS Japanese in each of the fresh-process runs that the card's Notes quote (a2fc_f7_d8 3 and fused_gpu16_d8 3 runs) — cpu_fp32; gpu16_fp16ws; a2fc_f7_d8; fused_gpu16_d8. Not records: the Mac's other P1 forms (cpu_int8f, fp16ws_gpu16_d8, int8m_m1_d32, int8m_m1_d8: not this repository's file set, or a pairing the card does not print), the subsets inside these runs (the S4 / S32 / J200 rows of the same processes), and the Mac's timing and parity-instrument runs. Records written.
